random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing abdominal tissue, likely the omentum or peritoneum. The specimen displays numerous small, whitish, chalky nodules scattered across the surface. These characteristic chalky yellow-white deposits represent fat necrosis. The findings are typical of acute pancreatitis resulting in enzymatic fat necrosis.
